Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its analysis of the search results. It incorrectly claimed that sources like Britannica, History.com, and World History Encyclopedia cite the death year as "322 BCE" or use a "323/322 BCE" notation that needs normalization to 322 BCE. In reality, all the cited sources (Britannica, History.com, World History Encyclopedia) consistently state the death year as **323 BCE**. The Planner introduced a false discrepancy and an incorrect "astronomical year" conversion logic to justify changing the answer from the correct 323 BCE to the wrong 322 BCE, leading to an incorrect final solution.
